summary: Known item-to-item crafting recipes backed by the selected inventory handle, with atomic consume/output and rollback.
useWhen: A game needs data-defined item transforms without writing inventory removal, output placement and rollback bookkeeping.
limitations: No currency costs, recipe discovery/unlocks, crafting skills, failure chance, stations, effects or UI; those remain consumer policy. Inputs and output must be item IDs from the selected inventory provider.
